records.evidence_quote: Purchase Requests
records.fetch_status: 404 Not Found on all 4 candidate API slugs; 200 OK on index/spec/help pages
records.limitation: NOT DOCUMENTED (searched: 10 named sources, 2026-08-05). CLEAN NEGATIVE, INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED AND EXTENDED. Purchase Requests exist as a Zoho ERP product feature (they appear in the ERP help-doc product navigation) but have NO REST API surface: no /erp/v3 endpoint, no module doc page, no entry in the 85-slug API nav, and no OpenAPI spec among the 78 in openapi-all.zip. Named sources checked: https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/purchase-request/ -> HTTP 404 | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/purchaserequests/ -> HTTP 404 | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/purchase-requests/ -> HTTP 404 | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/purchaserequest/ -> HTTP 404 | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/introduction/ -> HTTP 200, 85 distinct module slugs in nav; the only purchase-family slugs are purchase-order and purchasereceives; the string 'Purchase Request' does not occur anywhere in the page | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/openapi-all.zip -> HTTP 200, 78 OpenAPI specs; no purchase-request*.yml file and zero regex matches for purchase.?request|requisition across all 78 specs | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/purchase-order/ -> HTTP 200, no reference to purchase requests | WebSearch 'Zoho ERP API v3 purchase request endpoint purchaserequests' -> returned only purchase-order pages (ERP, Books, Inventory); no ERP purchase-request API page | WebSearch '"Zoho ERP" "purchase request" API create custom function deluge' -> returned only generic Zoho custom-function/Deluge docs, no ERP purchase-request API surface | https://www.zoho.com/en-in/erp/help/purchases/request-for-quotes/understanding-rfq.html -> HTTP 200; its product navigation lists 'Purchase Requests', 'Purchase Requests Operations' and 'Purchase Requests Analytic Reports', confirming the FEATURE exists in the product UI and help docs. ARCHITECTURAL CONSEQUENCE: a Purchase Request object must be carried by a Custom Module (POST /settings/modules then CRUD at /{module_name}), which is fully documented and evidenced in the custom-modules records of this lane. Note the custom-module record schema is flat (record_name + cf_* fields) with NO line_items array, so PR line items need a child module via parent_module_id, and PR->PO conversion must be built in workflow/Deluge - there is no documented convert endpoint.

records.evidence_quote: A Request for Quote (RFQ) is a procurement document used to invite vendors to submit price quotes for specific items or services.
records.fetch_status: 404 Not Found on all 4 candidate API slugs; 200 OK on help page
records.limitation: NOT DOCUMENTED (searched: 8 named sources, 2026-08-05). Same clean negative as Purchase Request: RFQ is a real Zoho ERP product feature with full help documentation and an award/surrogate-bid lifecycle in the UI, but has no /erp/v3 REST surface, no API nav entry and no OpenAPI spec. Named sources checked: https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/request-for-quote/ -> HTTP 404 | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/requestforquotes/ -> HTTP 404 | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/rfq/ -> HTTP 404 | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/quotes/ -> HTTP 404 | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/introduction/ -> HTTP 200, no quote/rfq/request slug among the 85 modules | https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/openapi-all.zip -> HTTP 200, zero matches for request.?for.?quot|rfq across all 78 OpenAPI specs; no such path in any spec | WebSearch 'Zoho ERP "request for quote" RFQ API documentation v3' -> returned only help/KB pages and community threads, no API reference | https://www.zoho.com/en-in/erp/help/purchases/request-for-quotes/understanding-rfq.html -> HTTP 200, feature confirmed to exist in product. Same Custom Module fallback applies. The help docs also show RFQ can draw items from multiple Purchase Requests, so a POC that models PR and RFQ as custom modules must build that many-to-one linkage itself.

No LIST/search endpoint for purchase receives. Confirmed negative, but it means a POC cannot enumerate receives; the reconciliation path from PO to receives is not evidenced by any documented endpoint and needs a runtime probe against a real org.

The purchase-receive line_items schema has no per-line link back to a PO line (no po_line_item_id). Whether partial/over-receipt is tracked per line, and where received-vs-ordered quantity is reconciled, is not documented.

Purchase Order 'submit' and 'approve' return only code+message; no approver identity, approval level, or approval-history field is documented. Multi-level approval state is not exposed in the documented PO schema - comments/history is the only observable trail.

POST /purchaseorders/{id}/comments marks expected_delivery_date as required alongside description, which is unexplained in the spec and looks like a schema defect. Needs a runtime probe before relying on it.

Custom module record schema in the spec is illustrative only (record_name + a sample cf_debt_amount field). The real field-definition API for adding custom fields to a custom module was not transcribed in this lane - needed before a Purchase Request custom module can be specified concretely.
